description: This file defines the 'MyTimesheetController' class, which manages the user interface and logic related to employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles pre-render setup, including creating default timesheets and passing data to the client-side component.
external_methods: OrangeHRM	raits	raits	raits	rait	raitAuthUser::getEmpNumber

classes.name: MyTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling timesheet-related views and actions for the authenticated user. It initializes the default timesheet if not already present and sets up the front-end component with relevant data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components before rendering the view, including creating default timesheet entry and setting the 'my-timesheet' component with optional start date from query parameters.

methods.name: createDefaultTimesheetIfNotExist
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for the current date and creates a new one if it does not. It associates the timesheet with the authenticated user.
